page.content:
Homeric epic of Odysseus' return and the slaughter of the suitors.

How Odyssey connects

  • Character: Odysseus — The Odyssey is the epic of Odysseus' return from Troy.
  • Creator: Homer — The Odyssey is attributed to Homer.
  • Work: Iliad — The Odyssey follows the Iliad as the nostos after Troy.

What is Odyssey?

The Odyssey follows Odysseus from Calypso and the Phaeacians through the wanderings — Cyclops, Circe, the Underworld — to the bow-contest in Ithaca.

Key threads lead to Odysseus, Homer and Iliad.
